description: This file defines an Android activity that demonstrates the use of a TextSwitcher widget to animate text changes, with fade-in and fade-out animations triggered by a button press.

classes.name: TextSwitcher1
classes.description: An Android activity demonstrating the use of TextSwitcher with fade animations and a button to update the displayed number.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, configures the TextSwitcher and button, and initializes the counter.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles button click events to increment the counter and update the TextSwitcher.

methods.name: updateCounter
methods.description: Updates the TextSwitcher text to display the current counter value.

methods.name: makeView
methods.description: Creates and returns a new TextView for use by the TextSwitcher.
